# Sample data set (rebuilt 2026-09-25)

**Generated by:** `node scripts/rebuild-sample-data.mjs` (modules in `scripts/rebuild/`). Re-running it is safe: every id is deterministic, the previous data folder is copied to `data/backups/pre-rebuild-<stamp>/` first, and `data/demo-seed.json` is regenerated so `CRM_SEED_DEMO=1` and `scripts/reset-demo-data.mjs` put the same set back.
**Plan:** `docs/sample-data-plan.md` lists every screen and panel, the collections behind it, and what the set must contain; check it before changing the generator.
**Why:** the old set mixed fictional employees (Priya, Maya, Renee, Noah, Samira, Luis, Olivia) with test records typed during development (ZZZ Company, Test Caller, Recovered account…), and had dispatch jobs for projects that did not exist. The owner asked for a clean set built around the real team, with real vendors, and with projects that have their prerequisite opportunities set to Won.

## Pipeline

One open opportunity per stage, each with activities and a next step: Lead (Alamo Precast), Qualify (Cedar Valley Fire, with the drone-demo photos as site-walk photos), Develop (Williamson County Fleet, site walk scheduled 2026-09-30 as a `scheduleEvents` site_walk), Proposal (Georgetown ISD, estimate → quote Sent), Negotiation (Riverside Chemical, quote Sent, customer packet Approved, waste authorization Sent, MSA In review), and one Lost (Sunbelt Poultry, to Lone Star HazMat). Every project below has a Won opportunity behind it.

Every job with photos has a Photo action with a submission (the template's, or an ad-hoc "Ad hoc: Photo" the way Front Line's + Activity creates it), so the photos show under Forms and submissions and in the post-work report. Every sample record has its own Sample action with the three photos Front Line requires (North view, Sample interval, Container label) taken from the 2026-07-14 sample-capture set and reused across samples. Samples with results carry structured `sampleResults` rows (TX1005 TPH ranges with a Tier 1 action level on the C6–C35 total) and the lab report files from `docs/uploaded files/` as `sampleLabReports` (SPL report on the Lone Star swale samples, DHL report on the Permian confirmation samples, where S-1 and S-2 exceed and carry the red dot). Sales-entered resource needs on every opportunity from Develop onward are generic, the way the owner types them ("Truck", "PPE", "Lab"), with vendor names only in the note.

Closed jobs carry the whole field record: status events on the ladder, assignments, a work plan from the job type template with every action Complete, Timer submissions (labor hours the invoice draft reads), time entries, mileage, material use (`jobResources` + `materialUsage`), equipment logs, photos on the Photo action, daily narratives, the post-job review, a response weather snapshot on emergencies, and crew ↔ dispatch messages. Invoices are itemized from the 2026 rate sheet with the fuel surcharge and the 18% fee as generated lines.

## Photos

The photos come from `C:\Users\Braden\OneDrive - BioRemedy\Photos`, matched to jobs by date and content: 2025-07-02/03 (diesel semi, the LiDAR job), 2025-08-06 (parking lot debris), 2025-09-19 (pipeline site) and 2025-09-20 (night pond treatment), 2026-02-18/19 (soil borings), 2026-05-01 (garage wash), `IMG_08xx` (crawlspace, with the owner's numbered captions), 2025-07-10 (drone demo at a fire station), `IMG_07xx` (ranch site), 2026-07-14 (sample jars and chain-of-custody labels, reused on every sample). Job dates in the sample set do not always match the photo dates. HEIC files are converted to 1600px JPEGs by the generator (Python `pillow_heif`). The 9/22 set was personal and was not used.

## Places, paperwork and the rest of the record

Every customer has a Primary and a Bill To address, the ones that receive material a Ship To, the two industrial accounts a Tax address, and every vendor Remit-To / Vendor Dispatch / Vendor Billing (54 addresses). Every customer has at least one facility with coordinates, a manager on it (`facilityContacts`), and the big accounts have divisions the contacts are filed under. Decision makers carry employment history; the two industrial deals have budget-owner / technical-evaluator connections; meetings carry their attendees as activity parties. Two leads, products and a pricing note on every quote, sales orders behind the three accepted quotes, four sales tasks, two dispatch conflicts (one open), seven expense receipts, a stock ledger that explains every on-hand count (opening count, PO receipts, field usage), the customer packet PDF on file for every active customer and the vendor form for every vendor (the requirement rows point at the documents), request documents on the two biggest job requests, one IT thread, and 19 GPS points (spill origins, containment points, sample points, staging, a truck's last ping).

## Real records the rebuild never touches

**Messages to IT** (`itMessages`, their screenshot `documents` with `entityType: "itMessage"`, and the upload files behind them) are real reports from real people. `scripts/rebuild/main.mjs` carries them over from the current data unchanged, deleted rows included, and leaves them out of `demo-seed.json`. The first rebuild on 2026-09-25 did replace them with a generated thread; the four real messages and three screenshots were restored from `data/backups/pre-rebuild-20260925T174431` the same day. Add any other collection that starts holding real work to `PRESERVED_COLLECTIONS` in `main.mjs` before the next rebuild.

## Equipment and consumables

Every `equipmentAssets` row and every `inventoryItems` row links to a 2026 rate sheet product (`productId`), in the categories the equipment screen knows (Vehicle, Vacuum / Vactron, Pump, Air Filtration, General equipment, Heavy Equipment). One asset is on maintenance hold (EXC-402) and the 4-gas meter has a bump test due, to exercise the alerts.

## What the rebuild also removed from the code

- `server.mjs` `defaultBackend` no longer ships fictional employees, users, jobs or customers. A fresh data folder starts with the reference catalog and the real roster only; sample data comes from `demo-seed.json` under `CRM_SEED_DEMO=1`.
- `app.js` lost the dead `demoUsers` list (Maya / Priya / Renee / Gina / Jordan); the placeholder `demoUser` is now the anonymous user.
- `index.html` placeholders "Priya Patel" and "Maya Chen" became real names.
- The ER job type template lost the four test tasks added to its Mobilize stage; the "VIP Client Emergency Response" test template is gone.
- Three pre-import placeholder products (UST remediation, asbestos containment, impacted soil disposal) are gone; the three generic cost-basis products stay because the cost report reads them.
